items.title: Solana DeFi Firms Orca and Loopscale Merge Under New Formation Brand
items.summary: Solana DEX Orca and lending platform Loopscale will operate as Formation, a New York company aiming to finance AI, energy, robotics and defense assets and eventually reach regulated U.S. markets.

items.title: Decrypt Money Accounts on Solana to Power The Information Exchange
items.summary: One self-custodial platform to power Earn, Swaps, Predictions and Perps on Decrypt, as it builds out its financial and intelligence market.

items.title: Securitize Brings Nvidia, Apple and Amazon Onchain With Tokenized Stocks on Solana
items.summary: The new Securitize Stocks product launches with 12 names backed one-to-one by real shares—preserving dividends and voting rights—trading first on Solana, with NYSE and OKX-ICE venues planned.

items.title: Securitize launches 1:1-backed tokenized stocks, starting with Apple, Nvidia, Strategy and more
items.summary: Securitize launches tokenized US stocks on Solana, backed 1:1 by real shares with dividends and USDC settlement.

items.title: Samsung Wallet Taps Solana for USDC Transfers on 82M US Galaxy Devices
items.summary: Users can send USDC across borders from late October, three months after Samsung teased stablecoin support without naming a blockchain.

items.title: Samsung to launch USDC transfers on Solana for US Galaxy users
items.summary: The South Korean tech giant said the feature is built into Samsung Wallet, with fiat on- and off-ramps, rather than a separate crypto app.

items.title: Samsung Partners with Solana to Natively Deliver Stablecoins in Samsung Wallet to 82 Million U.S. Galaxy Devices
items.summary: Beginning the last week of October 2026, Samsung Wallet will support USDC cross-border transfers on Solana across 82 million U.S. Galaxy devices.

items.title: Solana’s Orca merges with Loopscale in push to finance AI, robotics and defense
items.summary: Orca and Loopscale unite as Formation, targeting financing for AI, energy, robotics and defense.

items.title: Solana Ecosystem Roundup: September 2026
items.summary: September saw growth across tokenized stocks, stablecoins, payments, and DeFi. Tokenized equity supply reached $684 million, stablecoins hit $17.51 billion, and the network processed 3.18 billion non-vote transactions.

items.title: Solana Foundation Launches Solana DvP, an Atomic Settlement Program Built for Financial Institutions
items.summary: Onchain open-source delivery-versus-payment infrastructure, tailored for the world’s leading financial institutions

items.title: Introducing Solana Microscope: Program Monitoring and Alerts
items.summary: Microscope decodes Solana program and Squads multisig activity into Grafana dashboards and alerts for Slack, Telegram, and PagerDuty.

items.title: Solana x AI: The Democratization Layer
items.summary: Solana can give AI agents permissionless access to compute, training, identity, memory, and machine-native payments.

items.title: Solana Changelog: October 1, 2026
items.summary: Devnet lists Alpenglow as a notable feature gate alongside new Agave, Firedancer, Superbank, Web3.js, Kit, and program SDK releases.

items.title: Open USD Is Live on Solana
items.summary: Open USD is live on Solana, letting businesses mint and burn 1:1 for dollars at no cost, with over $1 billion committed to liquidity.
